notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.3
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now delete unwanted items from the inventory.
[*] Added text to make it more clear the Hero King can be defeated in the demo.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The skeleton cost reduction skill now affects level 2 + 3 skeletons.
[*] Monsters can no longer level up after dying.
[/list]

And in case you missed it, check out the v0.4.2 patch notes.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3136320/view/755037723268481543?

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.2
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now preview a hero's path through the dungeon. To see the preview, hover over the spawn point or the hero preview icon in the bottom right.
[*] Reworded some tooltips that describe how heroes move through the dungeon.
[*] Default volume level is 20% quieter.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] The price multiplier of levelled monsters has decreased from 4x -> 3x.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where merging monsters with artifacts would merge their buffs twice.
[*] Capped attack at 2 billion, preventing integer overflow issues with monster attack becoming negative.
[*] Fixed an issue where the resolution setting was not being saved in window mode.
[*] Fixed a crash that could happen when you had a level 3 monster in the loot deck.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who played the demo! I have a mountain of feedback to sort through and attempt to prioritize. Keep sharing your thoughts and I'll keep putting out patches.

notes.title: Choose Your Dark Path: Professions and Sinister Specializations
notes.content:
Greetings, future overlords! It’s time to sharpen your sinister strategies because the new [b]Profession System[/b] is here!

Try out professions, and shape your dungeon’s destiny, in the latest playtest update. Join by clicking the Request Access button on the store page.

[h2]What Are Professions?[/h2]
Professions are your key to specialization, allowing you to take on unique roles and abilities as the Dark Lord. You can wield up to two professions per run, each with its own skill tree packed with upgrades that let you refine your strategy. Librarian, chef, architect, life insurance salesman - it's all there.

[h2]How Do You Get Professions?[/h2]
Pick your starting profession at the beginning of each run, and visit academy nodes on the world map to learn a second. As you crush wave after wave of pesky heroes, you’ll earn Skill Points to invest in your chosen professions, unlocking new abilities, buffs, and game-changing perks.

[h2]Shape Your Dark Legacy[/h2]
With professions, no two runs are the same. Will you be a cursed necromancer, a diabolical archeologist, or a shadowy spellblade? The choice is yours.

See you in the playtest!

notes.title: Playtest is live!
notes.content:
The playtest is cooking, and you're invited. It's time to click that Request Access button on the store page and start playing an early build of the game.

The future of the game will be directly shaped by players. That means share your feedback loud and often.

[h1]What's Included[/h1]
The initial build focuses on core dungeon building mechanics. Place rooms, hire monsters, build constructs, battle heroes, and protect the Dungeon Heart. Traverse the world map, conquer towns, and try to reach the hero's castle to face off against the final boss, Saint Million the Hero King.

For this round of testing, you'll play as the Brutal Beast clan combined with the Chef profession. Future playtests will open up more options and content.

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
[b]Monster Clans[/b]
Each clan features a different set of monsters with a unique theme.

[b]Profession System[/b]
Use skill points to learn and upgrade professions during a run. This will be the core roguelite build-craft experience. Available professions are randomized, allowing each run to be different while creating a variety of improvised strategies.

[b]More map nodes[/b]
The overworld map is meant to be heavily expanded. Future nodes will include the tavern, where you can recruit new monsters types for the remainder of the run.

[b]A button to speed up combat[/b]
I know. That was requested back when the game was just a tech demo on itch. Don't worry, it's coming.
